messages:
sara: Deploy bot surfaced a push failure for image 'redwood/runtime:release-20260320' to ECR during the v2 rollout. Can someone take a look? :eyes:

deploy-bot: CI job #12847 - publish-image - FAILED
build logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/12847
error: failed to upload layer: denied: Upload not authorized for repository 'redwood/runtime' (ECR)

raj: I pulled the full logs — looks like creds were valid but the upload layer returned 403 from ECR. Happens sometimes during IAM key rotation windows.

maria: Confirming — our infra rotation ran at 10:00 UTC and there was a short window where the deploy role couldn't assume the publisher role. We should retry push, but also verify provenance/attestation wasn't lost.

kevin: Is there a GCR fallback? The build also pushed to gcr.io/redwood-internal/runtime:sha-9d4f6 earlier. If ECR push is flaky we can temporarily use the GCR image for the canary.

sara: Can we pin the canary to the GCR digest instead of the failing ECR tag? We need to avoid serving an unverified image.

raj: Yes, we have the digest: sha256:9d4f6c2b... I can patch the rollout to reference the digest in the canary route. Also will add a note to the release that the canonical ECR tag hasn't been updated yet.

maria: Plan: 1) retry publish after rotation finishes, 2) if publish still fails, republish the same image with a new tag that includes build metadata (e.g., release-20260320+1) and cosign sign it, 3) in the meantime pin canary to gcr digest.

kevin: Agreed. Quick commands for retry if someone needs them:
```bash
aws ecr get-login-password --region us-west-2 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com
docker tag runtime:local 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood/runtime:release-20260320
docker push 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood/runtime:release-20260320
# if push keeps failing: docker push ...:release-20260320+1 && cosign sign --key ksm://projects/redwood/cosign-key ...
```

sara: Also double-check image provenance: if we republish with +1 we must attach the same SBOM and attestations. Can't accept unsigned hotfix images for canary.

raj: I verified the build artifacts (SBOM and attestations) are in GCS under gs://ci-artifacts/12847/, so republishing is OK as long as we sign the new tag and attach the existing SBOM.

ops-bot: Rollout control suggestion: pause rollout, pin production to previous stable tag release-20260315-abcdef (digest: sha256:4b1a2c3d) until ECR tag is resolved.

maria: I'm on it — I'll attempt a manual push now that rotation finished. If it fails again I'll push release-20260320+1 and cosign. Will post logs here. :construction_worker:

kevin: Small note — let's avoid automatic re-tagging to a new semver. Use the +build metadata suffix to keep traceability (semver+metadata). Also update release notes: 'ECR push delay, using GCR digest for interim canary'.

sara: Change window decision: hold the broad rollout until 13:00 UTC to give time for republish and signature verification. If republish completed and signatures verified before then we can proceed with canary expansion.

raj: Patch applied to canary route to use gcr digest, and production pinned to previous stable tag as requested.

maria: Manual push attempt log: 
```
Pushing layer 3/8... OK
Pushing layer 4/8... Error: denied: Upload not authorized for repository 'redwood/runtime'
```
Retry with new tag and cosign started.

maria: Republish succeeded with tag release-20260320+1 and cosign signature attached. SBOM & attestation linked to new tag. Pushed to both GCR and ECR.

ops-bot: Canary resume recommended: promote canary from gcr digest to release-20260320+1 digest (sha256:9f8a7b6c). Schedule: canary expansion at 13:15 UTC unless objections.

kevin: No objections. I'll update release notes and prod checklist to reflect the +1 tag and the ECR transient issue.

sara: Thanks everyone. Note for postmortem: add an auth rotation guard to prevent publisher role being rotated during release windows or add a short rule to retry pushes automatically with exponential backoff and attestation preservation. :memo:

raj: Filed a follow-up ticket: INFRA-2142 - 'Add rotation-safe ECR publisher mechanism & automatic retry with preserved provenance'

sara: closing the thread after rollout expands. Good job. :tada:
